paite: Hiai Judah suante a-inkuan dungzui a amau a tuam dia seh a om ahi: Edom gamgi chiang, simlam pang Zin gamdai tan hial in, simtawp tanpha in akizalhsuk hi.
heading: Judah Gam Tan
english: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.

paite: Simlam gamgi bel, chi Tuipi simtawp a tuipi gam geng a pan simlam doh ahi.
english: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

paite: Simlam zuan in Akrabbim tan in apai zel a, Zin ava tung hi. Kadesh-barnea simlam ah atungkah a, Hebron ava tung a, Adar ah atoupai a, Karka akualkhum hi.
english: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

paite: Azmon ah apai zel a, Aigupta luita ah atuakkhia a; tuipi ah gamgi atawp hi. Hiai bel simlam pang gamgi ahi.
english: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.

paite: Suahlam pang gamgi bel Chi Tuipi ahi a, Jordan ah atawp hi. Mallam pang gamgi bel tuipi tuimeng a pan Jordan tun tawp chiang ahi.
english: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.

paite: Beth-hoglah ah atoupai a, Beth-arabah mal ah apai zel a; Reuben tapa Bohan suang ah apaitou zel hi.
english: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

paite: Akor Phaizang a pan Debir ah apaitou a, lui simlam a om Adummim atungkahna chin ah Gilgal lam zuan in mallam ah apai zel a; En-shemesh tuite ah apaipai a, En-rogel ah asuakkhia hi.
english: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

paite: Hinam tapa phaizang ah Jebuste gam pang simlam, huai tuh Jerusalem ahi, pha in apaitou a; Hinnom tang lam pang phaizang chin a om tang vum ah apaitou a, huai tuh Rephaim mallam pang phaizang tawp mahmah ahi.
english: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

paite: Mualvum a pan Nephtoah a luituite pha in apaisuak a, Ephron tang a khopite ah apai zel a; gamgi Baalah, huai tuh Kiriath-jearim ahi, lam ah apaisuk hi.
english: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);

paite: Baalah a pan tumlam pang ah Seir tang pha in akihekkual nawn a, mallam pang ah Jearim, huai tuh Kesalon ahi, Beth-shemesh ah apaisuk a, Timnah tawn in apai zel hi.
english: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

paite: Mallam pang Ekron zul ah apaikhia a, Shikron ah apaisuak a, Baalah tang ah apai zel a, Jabneel ah apawt a; tuipi ah atawp hi.
english: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

paite: Tumlam pang gamgi bel tuipi azat a za leh apiau chiang teng ahi. Huai gam chiang ahi Judah suante a dia a-inkuan uh dungzui a sehsak a om.
english: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.

paite: Jephunneh tapa Kaleb TOUPA'N Joshua thu apiak bang in Judah suante lak ah tantuam abawlsak a, huai tuh Kiriath-arba ahi, Arba bel Anan pa ahi a, akhopi ahihleh Hebron ahi.
heading: Kaleb In Hebron Leh Debir Azou / (Vai 1.11-15)
english: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of Yahweh to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

paite: Kaleb in huai khua a pan Anak tapate thum Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai adelhkhia hi.
english: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

paite: Huai a pan Debir khomite ava dou a; ama in Debir kho min Kiriath-sepher ahi.
english: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

paite: Kaleb in, "Kuapeuh Kiriath-sepher va dou a, va la zou peuhmah, azi ding in ka tanu Aksah ka pe ding," achi hi.
english: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”

paite: Kaleb unaupa Kenaz tapa Othniel in ava la zou a; huchi in azi ding in atanu Aksah aneisakta hi.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ava tun in, apa gam ngen ding in akuan a; asabiltung a pan akumkhia hi. Kaleb in akiang ah, "Bang na deih a?" ana chi hi.
english: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”

paite: Ama'n, "Hon vualzawl in. Simlam gam lah na hon peta ngal a. Tui nak neite leng hon pe tel lai in," achi hi. Huchi in tui nak nei saknungte leh khangnungte apeta hi.
english: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

paite: Hiai ahi Judah suante nam, a-inkuan uh dungzui a agouluah uh.
heading: Judah Khopite
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

paite: Simlam a Edom gamgi zul a Judah suante aneih khopi hiaite ahi uh: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
english: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

paite: Kinah, Dimonah leh Adadah;
english: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

paite: Kadesh, Hazor leh Ithnan;
english: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

paite: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
english: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

paite: Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth, Hezron (huai Hazor ahi),
english: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),

paite: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
english: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

paite: Hazar-gaddah, Hesmon, Beth-palet,
english: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

paite: Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba, Bizjothjah,
english: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

paite: Baalah, Ijim, Ezem,
english: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

paite: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah.
english: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,

paite: Ziklag, Madmannah leh Sansannah.
english: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

paite: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain leh Rimmon ahi ua; khopi tengteng, akhotate uh toh sawmnih-le-kua ahi.
english: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.

paite: Phaigam lam ah Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

paite: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
english: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

paite: Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,
english: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

paite: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah leh Gederothaim ahi ua, akhotate uh toh khopi teng sawm-le-li ahi uh.
english: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

paite: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad;
english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

paite: Dilean, Mizpah leh Joktheel;
english: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

paite: Lakish, Bozkath, Eglon;
english: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

paite: Kabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish;
english: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,

paite: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, Makkedah. Akhopel teng uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-guk ahi uh.
english: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

paite: Libnah, Ether, Ahsan,
english: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

paite: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
english: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

paite: Keilah, Akzib leh Mareshah. Akhopel teng uh toh khopi tengteng kua ahi uh.
english: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

paite: Ekron leh akhopite leh akhotate toh,
english: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

paite: Ekron a pan tuipi tanpha in Ashdod zul a om tengteng, akhotate uh toh.
english: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

paite: Ashdod leh akhopite leh akhotate: Gaza leh akhopite leh akhotate; Aigupta lui leh tuipi za leh agei chiang pha in.
english: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

paite: Singtang gam lam ah Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,
english: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

paite: Dannah leh Kirjath-sannah, huai tuh Debir ahi,
english: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),

paite: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim leh Gosen,
english: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

paite: Gosen, Holon leh Giloh; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-khat ahi.
english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

paite: Arab, Dumah, Eshean,
english: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

paite: Janum, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,
english: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

paite: Humtah leh Kiriath-arba, huai tuh Hebron ahi, huan Zior; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng kua ahi.
english: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

paite: Maon, Karmel, Ziph, Juttah,
english: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,

paite: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
english: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

paite: Kain, Gibeah leh Timnah; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm ahi.
english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

paite: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
english: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

paite: Maarath, Beth-anoth leh Eltekon; akhotate uh toh khopite tengteng guk ahi.
english: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

paite: Kiriath-baal, huai tuh Kiriath-jearim ahi, leh Rabbah; akhotate uh toh khopi nih ahi.
english: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

paite: Gamdai a Beth-arabah, Middin, Sekakah,
english: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

paite: Chi khopi Nibshan leh En-gedi; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng guk ahi.
english: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.

paite: Jerusalem a teng Jebuste ahihleh Judah suante'n adelhkhe zou kei ua, tuni tan in Jerusalem ah Judah suante leh Jebuste atengkhawm uhi.
english: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
